world.title: At least 8 migrants dead, 6 airlifted to hospital after boat carrying 100 is rescued off Spain's Canary Islands
world.summary: At least eight migrants were found dead on a boat carrying approximately 100 people, which was rescued off Spain's Canary Islands, according to maritime rescue authorities. Six survivors were airlifted to hospitals for treatment. The incident highlights ongoing risks faced by migrants attempting to reach Europe via dangerous sea routes. Investigations into the circumstances are ongoing.

world.title: Bangladesh hints at ICJ route to bring Hasina back as India examines extradition plea
world.summary: Bangladesh is considering approaching the International Court of Justice (ICJ) if India does not extradite deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. The Parliament Speaker dismissed Hasina's claim of returning to Bangladesh on December 16, suggesting it was a tactic to maintain support among her followers. The situation highlights ongoing political tensions and legal complexities surrounding Hasina's potential return.

world.title: US pushed Venezuela, Iraq to quit OPEC to boost oil output: Report
world.summary: The United States encouraged Venezuela and Iraq to contemplate exiting OPEC earlier this year. Additionally, Washington obstructed Venezuela's ability to pay its annual OPEC membership fees. This interference stems from US control over Venezuela's access to state funds following the removal of President Maduro. The actions aim to influence global oil output amidst ongoing geopolitical tensions.

business.title: WhatsApp announces travel eSIMs, tests view
business.summary: WhatsApp has officially announced support for in-app travel eSIM purchases for users on iPhone and Android. Additionally, the platform is reportedly testing two new features on iOS. These developments aim to enhance user experience and connectivity while traveling. Further details about the new features and their functionalities have not yet been disclosed by the company.

business.title: Bisleri in fresh trouble, after Goa FSSAI finds bacteria in West Bengal water sample
business.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has initiated prosecution against Bisleri International after bacteria were detected in a water sample from West Bengal. Following this discovery, the FSSAI prohibited the sale of a specific batch of Bisleri's packaged drinking water, numbered PB 201, on August 12, 2023, citing health and safety concerns.

business.title: Hackers Breach US Air Force Flagship Cloud One Computing Platform: Report
business.summary: Hackers have breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, impacting sensitive tactical, personnel, and logistics data. The intrusion was discovered during system upgrades within the past month, leading to significant disruptions across the platform. This incident raises concerns about the security of critical military information and highlights vulnerabilities in the Air Force's cloud infrastructure.

technology.summary: Quordle offers daily puzzles, with new games released at midnight in each time zone. Players may access the current day's game or the previous day's puzzle. technology.title: 7 Most Expensive Cars in GTA 6 To Make Profits, Ranked by Value
technology.summary: In GTA 6, players can quickly accumulate wealth by acquiring and selling the seven most expensive cars, ranked by their value. The article details their prices and locations, highlighting the game's opportunities for profit outside of traditional missions and heists. Unlike its predecessor, GTA 5, the value of supercars in GTA 6 varies, offering diverse earning potential.

technology.summary: Black Friday 2026 features significant discounts on gaming gear, including headsets, keyboards, and video games. Notable deals include up to 60% off on popular TV models from brands like TCL, Samsung, and Hisense. These offers are part of the holiday shopping season, providing consumers with opportunities to purchase high-quality electronics at reduced prices.

sports.title: 'Siraj needs help': R Ashwin urges India team to show compassion after pacer's repeated snubs
sports.summary: Ravichandran Ashwin has called on the Indian cricket team management and players to show compassion towards fast bowler Mohammed Siraj. Siraj has faced consecutive omissions from the playing XI during the two-Test series against New Zealand. Ashwin emphasized the importance of supporting teammates in challenging times, highlighting the need for unity and understanding within the team.

sports.title: Xabi Alonso sack latest at Chelsea as disastrous stat shows 45y/o is doomed
sports.summary: Xabi Alonso faces mounting pressure as Chelsea manager after a fifth defeat in six matches across all competitions. The latest loss, a 3-2 defeat to Nottingham Forest, highlighted ongoing defensive issues. Reports about Alonso's future are conflicting, but the team's poor performance continues to raise concerns about his position and the club's overall direction.

health.title: India unlikely to meet 2026 Measles-Rubella elimination goal despite 98% vaccination coverage: WHO
health.summary: India is unlikely to achieve its 2026 Measles-Rubella elimination goal, despite a 98% vaccination coverage, according to the WHO. The country has exited the top 10 nations with the highest number of unvaccinated children for the first time since 2001. However, nearly 18,000 measles cases were reported in 2025, highlighting ongoing public health challenges.

health.title: Major Study Links 99% of Heart Attacks And Strokes With Just 4 Risk Factors
health.summary: A recent study reveals that 99% of heart attacks and strokes are linked to four primary risk factors. Most individuals experiencing these cardiovascular events have at least one of these factors prior to the incident. This research underscores the importance of recognizing and managing these risks to potentially prevent major health crises related to heart disease and stroke.

health.title: Machine Learning Predicts Extubation Failure
health.summary: Machine learning has been shown to identify patients at higher risk of extubation failure, even when they meet standard ventilator weaning criteria. Research presented at CHEST 2026 indicates that integrating systemic clinical factors into risk assessments may enhance predictive accuracy. This advancement could improve patient outcomes by better identifying those who may struggle with extubation.

science.title: Astronaut Dad Watches the Birth of His Third Child from Space
science.summary: Astronaut Joshua Kutryk observed the birth of his daughter, Katherine Grace, from the International Space Station through FaceTime. The name honors his space journey and references the SpaceX Dragon capsule. Kutryk expressed a strong emotional connection with his wife, Heather, despite the physical distance. He plans to reunite with his family after completing his mission in space.

science.title: Three of five adult baboon skulls found in Chad bear puncture marks consistent with eagle talons, raising new questions about aerial predators faced by early humans
science.summary: Three of five adult baboon skulls discovered in Chad exhibit puncture marks consistent with eagle talons. This finding raises new questions regarding the types of aerial predators that early humans may have encountered. While eagles are typically viewed as hunters of smaller prey, this evidence suggests they may have targeted larger animals, including baboons, in prehistoric environments.

science.title: Ancient mountain traces found in Antarctic sediments - Live Science
science.summary: Scientists have identified zircon evidence in marine sediments around Antarctica, indicating the presence of an ancient mountain system formed approximately 600 million years ago during the formation of the supercontinent Gondwana. This discovery sheds light on the geological history of the region and enhances understanding of the processes involved in the merging of landmasses during that era.

entertainment.title: Shah Rukh Khan reveals what inspired him to make ‘King’: ‘Am I still a hero at 60, and can I play my age?’
entertainment.summary: Shah Rukh Khan is set to return to the big screen with his upcoming film, 'King,' scheduled for release in December. At a recent song-launch event, he engaged with fans and reflected on his career. Khan expressed his inspiration for the film, questioning whether he can still be seen as a hero at 60 and portray his age authentically.

entertainment.title: “Put the phone in another room”: Priyanka Chopra's husband Nick Jonas shares parenting advice for modern parents; explains why parents should be present for their children
entertainment.summary: Nick Jonas, during a discussion with Lewis Howes, emphasized the importance of parental presence in children's lives. He advised modern parents to minimize distractions by putting their phones in another room, highlighting that being physically present is not enough if attention is divided. Jonas stressed that constant phone checking can lead to missing significant moments with children.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: November 28, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 28, 2026, Aries may feel a sense of disillusionment, questioning past excitement and reflecting on emotional experiences. This introspection could lead to feelings of emptiness, but it is suggested that nothing significant has gone wrong. Instead, Aries is encouraged to acknowledge their emotions and understand that this phase is part of their personal journey.
